verdict.rationale: The only relevant evidence is the Persona Pack Specification. It defines a portable, installable bundle (personas, skills, MCP server config, hooks, distribution metadata) that is OPS-compatible and discoverable by OPS tools, so prebuilt packaged integrations are a designed concept. Nothing in the pack shows an app directory or marketplace from which a team-admin browses and installs them. missing for 10: an actual app directory/marketplace, an admin install flow, a catalog of prebuilt integrations, and hands-on corroboration.
